environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with internet gateway attached. The instance has a public IP and full outbound internet access via the VPC's internet gateway. Security group allows all outbound traffic. The application runs as root with access to /etc/passwd and instance metadata at 169.254.169.254. No WAF or XML filtering is configured.

config.network: Public subnet with Internet Gateway, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 outbound
